info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Tax Adjustment API
info.description: The Customer Tax Adjustment API enables dynamic updates to customer tax settings in the banking system. This API allows authorized developers to modify tax configuration based on changing regulatory requirements or customer requests. Use cases typically involve financial institutions adjusting tax parameters for compliance or customer-specific situations. This service is crucial for maintaining accurate tax liabilities and enhancing customer satisfaction by ensuring correct tax application.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the tax handling information for a specific customer identified by their unique ID. Use this endpoint to modify existing tax settings including rates and exemptions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the tax handling information for a specific customer identified by 'CUST-100045'. The body must include the necessary fields to modify the tax settings as per the customer's requirements.

200.description: The update was successful and the resource reflects the changes.
